Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent game sprite atlas, exactly TWO columns and SEVEN rows (14 isolated vehicles).
Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Redesign all seven generations of TANK DESTROYERS so they can never be mistaken for a tank or a self propelled howitzer. Every generation must have a VERY LOW flat wedge hull, fully enclosed sloping fixed casemate integrated into the hull, NO turret, NO tall cabin, NO open crew compartment. Long low tracks, broad flat roof, an extremely long slim horizontal high-velocity anti-tank gun emerging directly from the low front plate. The hull height is less than half its width. Later tiers retain this low wedge silhouette, gaining longer chassis, side skirts and increasingly sophisticated armor. Tier 6 twin long slender guns, tier 7 twin futuristic rail-like barrels built into low casemate. No turret at any tier.
Preserve target atlas two columns × seven rows, pairing the identical unit model per row in two genuine opposite camera views: left column rear three-quarter heading NE (gun extends upper right), right column front three-quarter heading SW (gun extends lower left). Upright isometric camera looking down 35 degrees, never rotate the whole bitmap or mirror a view. Make the guns easy to locate and separate from hull.
Preserve seven distinct tier palettes in order: light tan, olive green, weathered steel silver, forest camouflage, crimson black, slate blue, dark graphite with restrained brass trim. Each row more formidable and elaborate than above, maintaining class silhouette. Increase vehicle mass by tier. Gritty realistic pre-rendered classic strategy game art, crisp metal wear, readable form at small size, consistent top-left lighting.
No weapons firing, no muzzle flashes, no shells, no smoke, no FX, no people, no statues, no text, no badges, no gridlines. Genuine transparent background including all gaps. Each vehicle fully inside its cell with padding; no touching or overlap across 14 cells. Portrait canvas 1024x1536.
